task_summary: Assemble the dengue NS1 binder/switch report: methods, figures, reconciliations, bundle, report

steps.title: Write methods.md
steps.description: One unified methods document: tool versions + three conda envs; 4.5 Å heavy-atom contact cutoff; target-side, epitope-filtered (261-305) burial convention with the three-number distinction stated; 5-seed protocol; the original acceptance gate and the evidence-based reason it was abandoned (gate inversion, rho=-0.888); the replacement epitope-fidelity criterion (>=4 contacts in 261-305, >=2 of 5 hotspots incl >=1 from cluster A). Replaces per-finding methods paragraphs.

steps.title: Build the three missing figures
steps.description: Load figure-style, apply_figure_style() first. Fig for the rescue campaign (from rescue_results/summary CSVs), the Direction B re-derivation (from direction_b_burial.csv: epitope vs tip burial scatter r=0.707, 6/15 vs 0/15 vs 0/15 pass counts, 2B7 crystallographic reference), and the second-arm lead (from second_arm_conservation.csv: DENV1-4 84% vs EP2 vs beta-ladder, ZIKV risk, discriminating positions). Verify every claim-title against the plotted data before saving.

steps.title: Reconcile binder_status.md and next_steps.md
steps.description: Update binder_status.md: fold in rescue (two full-length-validated candidates beat nb_3) and charge-null; stop framing nb_3 as THE result; remove the refuted paratope-charge recommendation. Update next_steps.md: replace the superseded three-day close with the current position (charge hypothesis refuted, two new leads, ternary invalidated).

steps.title: Reconcile switch_construction_plan and corrections_ledger
steps.description: New version of switch_construction_plan.md: remove the two-VHH ternary prediction as minimum-viable deliverable (invalidated by 3G2 control) — the switch deliverable is the specification not a model; remove the retracted ~370 Å² burial ceiling and the retracted 'five hotspots unsatisfiable' claim; adopt C-to-C terminus fusion (supersedes N-terminus claim from truncated model). Extend corrections_ledger.csv with this session's retractions: burial ceiling refuted, hotspot unsatisfiability withdrawn, charge hypothesis refuted, ternary deliverable invalidated, tip criterion refuted.

steps.title: Build ns1_benchmark/ bundle
steps.description: Repo layout + README; one ranked-binder table tying design ID -> sequence -> structure -> scores for the full-length-validated candidates (onepi_pd_5_dldesign_1, seed5_pd_15_dldesign_1, nb_3, and the shortlist with the cropped-target caveat); the scoring harness (epitope-fidelity scorer: contacts in 261-305, per-seed hotspot frequency, on-epitope rate). This is a named certain deliverable and does not yet exist.

steps.title: Draft report.md
steps.description: Assemble the report from all deliverables. Lead-decision (binder result vs methods findings) raised as an open decision for the authors, not decided silently. Enforce the WHAT-MUST-NOT-BE-CLAIMED list: 'characterised against a crystallographic reference', per-seed hotspot frequencies, no pose convergence, switch = specification not model, unresolved mimicry risk, Zika cross-reactivity live risk. Frame negative results as deliverables.

desired_outputs: fig15_directionB_rederivation.png — Direction B tractability re-derivation figure
ns1_benchmark/ reproducible bundle (README, ranked-binder table, scoring harness, repo layout)

feasibility.rationale: All research compute is finished; this is pure assembly from 9 internally-consistent finding documents, 11 data tables, and existing structures. No new predictions. Main risk is reintroducing one of the documented traps (burial conventions, conservation-window lookups, the tied-rho caveat) — mitigated by working only from the current findings and the verified data tables.
